AuthUserDto.description: The authenticated user as exposed to the client.

CategoryDto.description: A category as returned by the merchant back-office.

CustomerDto.description: A customer as returned by the merchant back-office.

CustomerOrderDto.description: One order in a customer's order history.

MerchantDto.description: A shop owned by the caller, as returned by `GET /api/v1/merchants/mine`.

PagedResultOfCategoryDto.description:
One page of a collection, as returned by every list endpoint
(`?page=&pageSize=` per contract v1.2 §4).

PagedResultOfCustomerDto.description:
One page of a collection, as returned by every list endpoint
(`?page=&pageSize=` per contract v1.2 §4).

PagedResultOfCustomerOrderDto.description:
One page of a collection, as returned by every list endpoint
(`?page=&pageSize=` per contract v1.2 §4).

PagedResultOfProductDto.description:
One page of a collection, as returned by every list endpoint
(`?page=&pageSize=` per contract v1.2 §4).

ProductDto.description: A product as returned by the merchant back-office.

ProductImageDto.description: A product image as returned by the merchant back-office.

ShopSettingDto.description: One shop setting. string ShopSettingDto.Value is an arbitrary JSON document.

TagDto.description: A tag as returned by the merchant back-office.

TenantSummary.description: A shop the caller belongs to, as returned by the auth and merchant endpoints.

UpdateCategoryRequest.description: Request body of `PATCH /merchant/categories/{id}` — every field optional.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Request body of `PATCH /merchant/customers/{id}` — every field optional.

UpdateProductRequest.description: Request body of `PATCH /merchant/products/{id}` — every field optional.

UpdateSettingsRequest.description: Request body of `PUT /merchant/settings` — replaces the whole set.

Bearer.description: Access token issued by POST /api/v1/auth/telegram (HS256 JWT, 60 minutes).
